_doc: Courtship and marriage rules (Family system). adult_age: minimum age in years to court or marry. courtship: min_favor (favor with the NPC needed to court them), favor_gain (favor per courtship outing), charisma_step (each this many Charisma points above 10 adds +1 favor_gain, below 10 removes 1; minimum gain 1), days (time per outing). proposal: min_favor (needed to propose), max_realm_gap (major realms apart, either way), max_alignment_gap (alignment points apart; righteous and demonic clash), days. concubine_rank: the rank id that a proud NPC (npcs.json 'proud': true) or one of a higher major realm than the proposer refuses. genders: one entry per data/names.json gender: partner_genders (genders this character may court) and ranks (rank id -> {name, max, max_per_realm (optional; extra slots per major realm index of the proposer)}). dual_cultivation: qi_bonus (extra qi fraction for both partners cultivating together, e.g. 0.5 = +50%), realm_step (bonus multiplier per major realm the partner is above you, below lowers it), min_factor/max_factor (clamp of the partner factor = sqrt(partner root multiplier) * (1 + realm_step)^gap), favor_per_month (favor each living spouse gains per month of game time), favor_per_session (favor from cultivating together), max_favor (passive and session favor stop here). eligible_npcs (optional): generated courtship candidates kept in every region at session start and on load (Npcs.ensure_eligible): per_gender (unmarried adult generated NPCs of each data/names.json gender per region), age_min/age_max (years), proud_chance (0-1, chance a spawned NPC is proud and refuses concubinage), realms_by_danger (list indexed by the region danger, clamped to the last entry; each entry is a list of realm ids to pick from). children (FAM-003, optional): carrier_gender (the partner who carries a pregnancy; a couple without exactly one cannot conceive and must adopt), conception_days (time spent per attempt), conception_chance (0..1 per attempt), pregnancy_days, max_mortal_carrier_age (a mortal carrier older than this cannot conceive; cultivators can), genius_chance (0..1, child gets a single high-purity root regardless of parents), genius_purity_min, mutation_chance (0..1, the element count shifts by one, and per parent element it may be replaced by a new element), purity_variance (+- on inherited purity), attribute_variance (+- on the parents' attribute average), cultivation_start_age (years before a child can cultivate). adoption (FAM-003b, optional; Adoption system): max_age (oldest child in years that can be adopted, below adult_age), days (time the adoption takes), alignment (alignment shift for taking in a child), favor (the child's starting favor with the adopter), take_surname (true = the child takes the adopter's surname), max_adopted (adopted children per character), foundling_donation (spirit stones asked by an orphanage/temple for a foundling), foundling_age_min/foundling_age_max (years; foundlings are newly generated children). npc_families (FAM-003d, optional; NpcFamilies system): off-screen NPC family life, simulated monthly: marriage_chance_per_year (0..1, chance an unmarried eligible generated NPC marries an unrelated eligible NPC of the same region; NPCs the player knows never do), attempt_chance_per_month (0..1, chance a married NPC couple tries for a child that month, then children.conception_chance applies), max_children (a mother stops at this many children), population_cap (soft cap: no NPC conceptions while this many NPCs are alive; pregnancies under way and courtship-candidate refills can still exceed it).
